description: Flat metadata schema for individual bacterial metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) recovered from soil samples collected across geographic locations, including binning provenance, software/parameter details, and genome quality metrics for comparative ecology and adaptation analyses.

mag_id.descr: Unique identifier for the MAG record (e.g., 'MAG_0001').

sample_id.descr: Identifier of the soil metagenomic sample from which the MAG was recovered.

project_id.descr: Project or study identifier linking multiple MAGs and samples within the same investigation.

collector_name.descr: Name or identifier of the person or group that collected the soil sample.

collection_date.descr: Date when the soil sample was collected (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD).

country.descr: Country where the soil sample was collected.

state_province.descr: State, province, or equivalent administrative region of collection.

site_name.descr: Human-readable site name or field location label.

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling site in meters above sea level.

soil_depth_cm.descr: Depth interval of soil collection in centimeters (e.g., topsoil depth).

soil_type.descr: Soil classification or descriptor (e.g., loam, clay, sandy soil).

habitat_type.descr: Broad habitat category for the sampling site (e.g., forest, grassland, agricultural field, desert).

biome.descr: Biome designation for the sampling location (e.g., temperate forest, tundra, arid shrubland).

land_use.descr: Land-use category at the sampling site (e.g., natural, agricultural, urban, restored).

ph.descr: Soil pH measured for the sampling site.

moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content as percentage by mass or volume, as reported.

temperature_c.descr: Soil or near-surface temperature in degrees Celsius at collection or measurement time.

organic_carbon_percent.descr: Soil organic carbon content as percent of dry soil mass.

nitrogen_percent.descr: Total soil nitrogen content as percent of dry soil mass.

sample_remarks.descr: Free-text notes about the sample or field conditions that may affect interpretation.

dna_extraction_method.descr: Method or kit used for DNA extraction from soil.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used to generate metagenomic reads (e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, HiSeq).

read_type.descr: Sequencing read layout (e.g., single-end, paired-end, long-read, hybrid).

library_preparation_protocol.descr: Library preparation protocol used prior to sequencing.

assembly_software.descr: Software used to assemble metagenomic reads into contigs prior to binning.

assembly_version.descr: Version of the assembly software used.

assembly_parameters.descr: Key assembly parameters used (e.g., k-mer settings, minimum contig length), recorded as a concise string.

contig_min_length_bp.descr: Minimum contig length retained for downstream binning, in base pairs.

binning_algorithm.descr: Primary binning algorithm used to recover this MAG (e.g., MetaBAT2, MaxBin2, CONCOCT).

binning_software_version.descr: Version of the binning software used.

binning_parameters.descr: Key binning parameters used (e.g., tetranucleotide frequency, coverage thresholds), recorded as a concise string.

refinement_method.descr: Optional MAG refinement or consolidation method used after initial binning (e.g., DAS Tool, manual curation).

refinement_parameters.descr: Key parameters used during MAG refinement, recorded as a concise string.

binning_round.descr: Binning iteration or round number if multiple rounds were performed.

coassembly.descr: Indicates whether the MAG came from a single-sample assembly or a co-assembly.

coverage_mean_x.descr: Mean read coverage of the MAG across the contributing sample(s), in X-fold coverage.

coverage_min_x.descr: Minimum coverage threshold used or observed for bin retention, in X-fold coverage.

completeness_percent.descr: Estimated genome completeness of the MAG, expressed as a percentage.

contamination_percent.descr: Estimated genome contamination of the MAG, expressed as a percentage.

strain_heterogeneity_percent.descr: Estimated strain heterogeneity or within-bin variability, expressed as a percentage if available.

checkm_version.descr: Version of the quality-assessment tool used to estimate completeness and contamination (e.g., CheckM/CheckM2).

quality_category.descr: Quality category for the MAG (e.g., high-quality, medium-quality, low-quality) according to the study or MIMAG-like criteria.

num_contigs.descr: Number of contigs assigned to the MAG.

total_length_bp.descr: Total assembled genome length of the MAG in base pairs.

n50_bp.descr: Contig N50 of the MAG assembly in base pairs.

gc_percent.descr: Mean GC content of the MAG, expressed as a percentage.

largest_contig_bp.descr: Length of the largest contig in the MAG, in base pairs.

taxonomy_domain.descr: Taxonomic domain assignment for the MAG (expected value typically 'Bacteria').

taxonomy_species.descr: Assigned species or closest species-level match, if available.

taxonomy_method.descr: Method used for taxonomic assignment (e.g., GTDB-Tk, Kraken2, phylogenomic placement).

taxonomic_confidence.descr: Confidence score or qualitative confidence for taxonomic assignment, if available.

marker_gene_count.descr: Number of single-copy marker genes detected for quality assessment or phylogenomic placement.

rRNA_detected.descr: Indicates whether rRNA genes were detected in the MAG.

tRNA_count.descr: Number of tRNA genes detected in the MAG.

antibiotic_resistance_genes_count.descr: Count of detected antibiotic resistance genes, if analyzed.

stress_response_genes_count.descr: Count of detected stress-response genes relevant to soil adaptation, if analyzed.

carbon_metabolism_pathways_present.descr: Boolean indicating whether key carbon metabolism pathways were identified.

nitrogen_metabolism_pathways_present.descr: Boolean indicating whether key nitrogen metabolism pathways were identified.

phosphorus_acquisition_genes_present.descr: Boolean indicating whether phosphorus acquisition genes were identified.

osmoprotection_genes_present.descr: Boolean indicating whether osmoprotection genes were identified.

desiccation_tolerance_genes_present.descr: Boolean indicating whether desiccation tolerance genes were identified.

metal_resistance_genes_present.descr: Boolean indicating whether metal resistance genes were identified.

assembly_accession.descr: Optional accession or repository identifier for the assembly or MAG sequence.

database_release_version.descr: Version of the reference database used for annotation or taxonomy calls.

curation_status.descr: Manual curation status of the MAG (e.g., raw bin, refined, manually reviewed, finalized).

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to interpretation, including caveats about the binning process or environment.
